client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of the Jortt OAuth application, registered under Settings > API in your Jortt administration.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the Jortt OAuth application.

organization_id.title: Organization ID
organization_id.description: Administration to read. Required when the credentials may act on more than one administration; the check fails and lists the available IDs when it is omitted in that case.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Optional lower bound for the expenses stream. Leave empty to read the full history; when set, expenses with an earlier VAT date are not read, on full refresh as well as on the first incremental run.

lookback_days.title: Lookback days
lookback_days.description: How many days before the incremental cursor the expenses filter starts. Expenses booked late carry an old VAT date, so a window wider than zero is needed to pick them up.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request. Leave empty to use the read-only scopes the source needs.
scopes.default: customers:read invoices:read estimates:read expenses:read organizations:read reconciling:read
